//: The Stenchmaster Entertainment System (Story Phase 5; see src/systems/tv/tv.js and src/ui/TvView.js). A CRT Garrick built out of a lantern, a compass, cutlery, a cannon lock, bottles, a bit of the old bell and the barometer. None of those things can become a television. It is one anyway, and nobody knows why. Comments are lists of looks, taken in turn; a line from someone who isn't on deck is skipped. Programming is mysterious on purpose: no named shows, no characters, nothing explained.

ses.name: The Stenchmaster Entertainment System
offComments: captain: It's off. The glass is still warm. It's always warm.
garrick: It's resting, Captain. Like me.
captain: Dark. Somewhere inside it, something ticks.
captain: My own reflection, in green. Beard and all. It's not a good angle.

channels.title: Static
comments: captain: Static.
garrick: Live static.
captain: Still static.
garrick: It's building up to something.
captain: How long have ye watched this one?
garrick: Since Tuesday.
captain: It's Thursday.
captain: I've been staring at the snow and I think it's staring back.

channels.title: Weather
comments: captain: A weather map. Of... somewhere. That coastline isn't on any chart I own.
garrick: Very reliable forecasts, that place.
captain: It's snowing there. Upwards.
garrick: Seasonal.
captain: There's a little sun with a face on it, and it looks worried.
garrick: It's a sensitive broadcast.
captain: Those are our coordinates in the corner. It says 'BAD'.
garrick: Second opinion. Always welcome.

channels.title: Potatoes
comments: captain: A man peeling potatoes. He hasn't looked up once.
garrick: He's very good.
captain: He's still peeling potatoes.
garrick: It's a long programme.
captain: Same man. Same potatoes. Is it the SAME potato?
garrick: Don't spoil it.
captain: ...It is quite calming.
garrick: I know.

channels.title: A Fish
comments: captain: A fish.
garrick: Mm.
captain: The same fish. Going round.
garrick: It's a recurring feature.
captain: Is it the same fish every time, or a lot of fish who look alike?
garrick: That's the question, isn't it, Captain.
captain: At least it isn't a shark.
garrick: Not yet.

channels.title: The Theatre
comments: captain: The man arguing with the turnip.
garrick: Act Two. It gets very tense.
captain: The turnip still hasn't said anything.
garrick: It doesn't need to. The silence says it all.
captain: I think he's losing.
garrick: He always loses. That's the tragedy.
captain: Who is he? Where IS this?
garrick: Important cultural programming, Captain. Don't ask questions during the performance.

channels.title: Whispers
comments: captain: Static. With... whispering. Very faint.
garrick: Ah. That one.
captain: It sounds like somebody saying a list. Too quiet to make out.
garrick: I've never caught the end of it either.
captain: I don't like this channel.
garrick: Nobody likes this channel. I watch it anyway. Professionally.
captain: ...It stopped when I leaned in.
garrick: It does that.

channels.title: The Frog Tax Man
comments: captain: The frog again.
garrick[delighted]: FRANKLIN, Captain. Have some respect.
captain: He's being audited.
garrick: He's ALWAYS being audited. That's what makes it good.
captain: I don't understand a word of this.
garrick: Nobody does, Captain. That's what makes it TAX.
captain: ...Did he itemize?
garrick[proud]: Now you're watching it properly.

wiring: captain: I recognise none of this.
captain: One of these is tied to a spoon.
captain: There's a bit of the old bell wired in at the back. It's warm.
captain: The compass from the jolly boat. It's spinning. It's pointing at the screen.
garrick: Even the compass watches it, Captain.
powerSource: captain: A cask, a coil of copper, a cannon lock and three bottles of something green, all wired together.
captain: There is no sensible reason this should work.
captain: Where does the power COME from?
captain: The bottles are Frog Grog.
garrick: Very high-energy beverage, Captain. I've always said so.
slap: garrick: Firmly. On the side. There.
captain: That shouldn't have worked either.
captain: I hit it, and it got better. I don't know how I feel about that.
garrick: You have to show it who's in charge.

lines: pete: It's going to BLOW!
garrick: It's perfectly normal.
captain: It's smoking.
garrick: That's the picture warming up.
gristle: Everybody get DOWN!
garrick: Overreaction, Mister Gristle. Give it a slap.
captain: That noise is not a television noise.
garrick: It's a very normal noise. For this television.
captain: The picture's rolling.
garrick: Vertical hold. Slap it.
captain: ...There's a tiny white dot in the middle of the glass. It wasn't there a moment ago.
captain: It ticked. I'm sure it ticked.

lookComments: captain: Nothing. The glass is still warm. It shouldn't be warm.

lines: captain: The cracked glass flickers grey for a moment. Then nothing.
captain: A crackle, a smell of hot dust, and quiet.

lookComments: captain: A shark came through the wall and hit it square. The glass is a spider's web. There's a tooth in the cabinet.
garrick[worried]: Don't LOOK at it like that, Captain. It can tell.
captain: Bitten, cracked, sooted, and the aerial's flat. It's finished.
captain: I'm not touching it. Nobody is touching it. That's the only rule I need tonight.

wrecked.//: Story Phase 7: the second shark finished it, and Garrick took what was left for Mark II. Its history stays (it was working, apparently dead, shark-damaged); this is the last condition. It does not flicker.
lookComments: captain: A shark accomplished what I could not.
captain: ...And then Garrick took the rest.
captain: No glass. No tubes. No knobs. Somebody has chalked PARTS on it.
captain: The original Stenchmaster Entertainment System. Rest in pieces.
garrick[worried]: It gave everything, Captain. Literally. I took it.

knobs.//: Story Phase 6 (Chapter 26): the back panel Garrick labelled himself. Turn knobs until OFF MAYBE takes (on the third try); every wrong knob does something, none of them hurt. Nobody reaches inside; these are the knobs on the outside.
openLines: captain: Seven knobs. In crayon. LOUD. MORE LOUD. PICTURE MAYBE. DO NOT TOUCH. FROG. ???. OFF MAYBE.
bob[alarmed]: Why is only one of them 'off', Captain?

list.label: LOUD
lines: captain: LOUDER. Of course it's louder.
bob[alarmed]: Captain, the sharks can hear the laugh track!
captain: Still louder. Garrick snores straight through it.

list.label: MORE LOUD
lines: The whole set shudders. The laugh track rattles the cutlery.
bob[alarmed]: WHY WOULD YOU TURN THAT ONE?
captain: I wanted to KNOW.

list.label: PICTURE MAYBE
lines: The picture flips upside down. Franklin carries on, upside down, with tremendous dignity.
bob: He's still talking about the lily pad.
The picture flips back. Franklin doesn't seem to have noticed either time.

list.label: DO NOT TOUCH
lines: You touch it. The picture goes a deep bruised colour. Franklin looks unwell.
bob[alarmed]: It SAID do not touch!
captain: It says a lot of things.
The colour goes green. Greener. Franklin seems happier.

list.label: FROG
lines: The picture lurches into an enormous close-up of Franklin's face. His glasses fill the screen.
bob[alarmed]: He's LOOKING at us.
captain: He's looking at his taxes.
Franklin's face shrinks back to normal. Somehow worse.
The set honks. Then the programme slows to a crawl. Franklin's voice drops an octave and stretches out like warm tar.
bob[alarmed]: I... TOOK... THE... STANDARD...
captain: Don't you start.
It speeds back up. The honk was apparently unrelated.

list.label: OFF MAYBE
lines: The picture shrinks to a dot... thinks about it... and comes back.
captain: MAYBE.
Dot. Pause. Back again, slightly louder, out of spite.
bob: Is it meant to do that?
captain: It's meant to be OFF.
doneLines: The picture folds down to a single white dot. The laugh track drains away into nothing.
Silence. Real silence. The sea. Garrick snoring.
